Sermon: God is our shield and defender.
He leads us to everlasting life.
The Lord is our strong tower.
His love is our greatest treasure.
Christ is the bread of life.
He gives strength to the weary.
God’s mercy is new each morning.
He is our guide in the storm.
The Lord makes all things possible.
In Him, we find true freedom.
He knows the desires of our hearts.
The Lord is our eternal refuge.
In His presence, we find joy.
He lights the way for His people.
We rest in His perfect peace.
